# Unsession

> Unsession is a conference session management platform for organizers and program teams. It runs the speaker side of an event: call for proposals, reviews, decisions, speaker onboarding, and a published agenda.

Unsession is open source and runs on Cloudflare Workers. It has a REST API and an MCP server, so AI agents can read and manage event data directly.

## Docs

- [API and MCP documentation](https://unsession.dev/docs/mcp): How to connect an agent through MCP with OAuth, and how to call the REST API with a token.

## API

- [REST API](https://unsession.dev/api/v1): Base URL for the v1 API. Resources: events, forms, submissions, sessions, speakers, agenda, and tasks.
- [MCP server](https://unsession.dev/api/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. Authenticate with OAuth or an API token.

## Public pages

- [Event directory](https://unsession.dev/events): List of published events on this instance.
- Each event has public pages at `https://unsession.dev/<event>/agenda` (HTML) and `https://unsession.dev/<event>/agenda.json` (JSON).

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/cvolzer3/unsession): Source code, issues, and license.
